Mina: Tiny idea  Pocket LAN + chill couch co-op Thursday? Bring any handhelds, a Deck, or just yourself. Planning 6:30pm in Lounge C. Low-key, BYO controller. :game_die: :coffee:

Omar: love it. I can bring my Steam Deck and a travel router for a private LAN. Also a spare Steam key for Overcooked 2 if anyone wants it.

Jess: i'll bring a Switch Lite and two joy-cons. Snacks? I can do salted caramel pretzels (labeled).

Ravi: count me in. will bring an ethernet switch and my docked Switch. Can join remotely for a few rounds if baby bedtime wins.

Mina: plan: 6:15 setup, 6:30 indie rotation (TowerFall/Tiny Heist), 7:15 big couch rounds (Overcooked/Mario Kart). Remote folks on Remote Play Together.

Omar: heads-up: Remote Play can be funky for frame-sensitive games; we can queue party games for remote players.

Jess: snacks-bot, please remind folks to label allergens.

snacks-bot: Reminder queued: please label any homemade dishes with allergens.

ops-bot: Reservation requested for Lounge C 6:00pm-9:00pm. Please confirm AV: "TV+HDMI" or "Projector".

Mina: TV+HDMI please. Who can bring extra controllers? Reply with type.

Omar: 2x USB pads

Jess: 2x joy-cons (have extras)

Ravi: 1x Pro Controller

Mina: quick attendance check: reply Y/N if coming in person (remote okay).

Jess: Y

Omar: Y (might leave ~8:30)

Ravi: Partial (remote after 8pm)

Mina: great! I'll post the Remote Play link and a tiny schedule tomorrow. Low-pressure, cozy vibes only. :sparkles:
